{
	"name": "dot-prop",
	"version": "10.2.0",
	"description": "Get, set, or delete a property from a nested object using a dot path",
	"license": "MIT",
	"repository": "sindresorhus/dot-prop",
	"funding": "https://github.com/sponsors/sindresorhus",
	"author": {
		"name": "Sindre Sorhus",
		"email": "sindresorhus@gmail.com",
		"url": "https://sindresorhus.com"
	},
	"type": "module",
	"exports": {
		"types": "./index.d.ts",
		"default": "./index.js"
	},
	"sideEffects": false,
	"engines": {
		"node": ">=20"
	},
	"scripts": {
		"test": "xo && ava && tsc",
		"bench": "node benchmark.js",
		"coverage": "c8 ava"
	},
	"files": [
		"index.js",
		"index.d.ts"
	],
	"keywords": [
		"object",
		"prop",
		"property",
		"dot",
		"path",
		"get",
		"set",
		"delete",
		"access",
		"notation",
		"dotty",
		"dottie",
		"unflatten",
		"expand"
	],
	"dependencies": {
		"type-fest": "^5.0.0"
	},
	"devDependencies": {
		"ava": "^6.4.1",
		"benchmark": "^2.1.4",
		"c8": "^10.1.3",
		"expect-type": "^1.2.2",
		"typescript": "^5.9.2",
		"xo": "^1.2.2"
	}
}
